seo.title: Radar Puls | Police and speed camera reports in real time
seo.description: Radar Puls helps drivers quickly see police, camera and checkpoint reports powered by the community.

hero.title: Police and radar reports. Fast, clear and in one place.
hero.description: Radar Puls digitizes field reports and turns them into practical information for daily driving.
hero.note: Landing MVP is live. Map and reporting arrive in the next phase.

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.point1: Most updates are currently buried in long Facebook comment threads.
problem.point2: Drivers need a quick and simple view of police checks and cameras.
problem.point3: Radar Puls brings reports into one place and prepares the ground for a live map.

how.title: How Radar Puls works
how.step1Desc: Drivers share updates from the road in real time.
how.step2Desc: Reports are organized by type: police, camera, control, incident.
how.step3Desc: A cleaner road overview before you start driving.

q1.question: Is Radar Puls free?
q1.answer: Yes, the core app experience is planned as free for all drivers.

q2.question: How do I report police or radar?
q2.answer: You open the app, choose report type and location, then submit in a few taps.

q3.question: Which cities are covered?
q3.answer: MVP starts with Nis and nearby area, then expands city by city.

q4.question: Is this legal to use?
q4.answer: Radar Puls is an informational community platform. Users must follow local traffic laws.

q5.question: How does trust and accuracy work?
q5.answer: Reports are validated through community confirmations and future reputation scoring.

q6.question: When is live map launching?
q6.answer: A countdown is shown on this page and launch updates will be announced there.
